title: PJM Membership Elects Janet Dietrich to Board of Managers

meta.summary: PJM Interconnection announced today that its Members have elected Janet Dietrich to the PJM Board of Managers. The process for electing Board members is set forth in the FERC-approved PJM Operating Agreement.
